title: Migrate detail flow to parsed catalog entries
description: Update the recipe detail presentation path so selection and sheet rendering use a richer catalog-backed recipe entry with parsed `Recipe` content already available. Remove the detail view's parse-on-appear task and loading placeholder while keeping existing bottom-bar integrations working.
acceptance_criteria: The selected item presented from the recipes list carries or can resolve the parsed `Recipe` from the catalog without disk re-parsing on sheet open.
`RecipeDetailSheet` no longer performs its own file read/parse task or shows the transient loading state for normal catalog-backed opens.
Any directly impacted recipe UI types and sheet call sites compile against the replacement entry type instead of `RecipeFile`.

handoff_summary.completed: All acceptance criteria met: (1) `RecipeEntry` carries the parsed `Recipe` — no disk re-parse on sheet open; (2) `RecipeDetailSheet` no longer has a `.task(id:)` load step or `ProgressView` loading state; (3) `RecipeDetailSheet`, `RecipeHeroHeader`, `RecipeRowView`, `RecipesListView`, `AddToMealPlanSheet`, `MealPlanItemRow`, and `MealPlanDetailView` all compile against `RecipeEntry` instead of `RecipeFile`. Bottom-bar integrations (`AddToMealPlanSheet`, `AddToShoppingListSheet`) continue working — the former now receives `recipeEntry: RecipeEntry` and uses `.url`, the latter receives `recipe: recipe.recipe`. `RecipeCatalog` static helpers marked `nonisolated` to fix pre-existing Swift 6 concurrency error blocking the build.
handoff_summary.remaining: No outstanding work for this bead.
handoff_summary.risks: MealPlanDetailView now captures `recipeCatalog.sections` before the detached load task — correct for the warm-catalog path but falls back to inline parsing for any recipe referenced in a meal plan that isn't in the catalog (e.g. stale path, catalog not yet loaded). The fallback produces a `RecipeEntry` with an empty `Recipe()`; in the rare case the catalog is empty at plan-open time the recipe detail sheet would show an empty recipe until the catalog reloads.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for verification of catalog-backed detail open (no flash/loading state), bottom-bar add-to-meal-plan and add-to-shopping-list flows, and meal plan detail recipe tap path.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipeCatalog.swift touched to fix nonisolated issue — sibling beads modifying that file should rebase cleanly since the change is additive (keyword-only). MealPlanDetailView.swift now reads from RecipeCatalog environment; any bead that restructures MealPlanDetailView should be aware of the new @Environment(RecipeCatalog.self) dependency.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: MealPlanDetailView was updated to use RecipeCatalog for lookup rather than keeping RecipeFile, because changing RecipeDetailSheet to RecipeEntry would otherwise require a separate init overload or protocol. The catalog-first lookup eliminates double-parsing for the common path; inline fallback (parse from disk) covers stale or not-yet-catalogued references without breaking the meal plan flow.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No test files were modified. Existing MealPlan and AddToMealPlanSheet tests should be checked for compilation against the renamed recipeEntry parameter. The expected_globs include those test files.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: RecipeFile type is kept (used by RecipeDiscovery dead code) but is no longer part of any live call path. It can be removed in a follow-up cleanup bead once RecipeDiscovery is also removed.

conflict_risks: RecipeCatalog.swift touched to fix nonisolated issue — sibling beads modifying that file should rebase cleanly since the change is additive (keyword-only). MealPlanDetailView.swift now reads from RecipeCatalog environment; any bead that restructures MealPlanDetailView should be aware of the new @Environment(RecipeCatalog.self) dependency.

execution_history.summary: Migrated the recipe detail presentation path from `RecipeFile` to `RecipeEntry`. All catalog-backed call sites now pass the already-parsed `Recipe` directly; `RecipeDetailSheet` no longer loads or parses from disk on open. The pre-existing `RecipeCatalog` `nonisolated` Swift 6 concurrency error was also fixed in the same pass.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
